name: Teen Leaders Club and Changemakers
what_you_do: Join Leaders Club or Changemakers. In Leaders Club, teens lead projects, plan events, do service projects, and connect with mentors. It can include travel to conferences. In Changemakers, teens work on causes they care about, with advocacy and public speaking.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12. Leaders Club requires being a Y program member or facility member; the page states no membership rule for Changemakers. A Jr. Leaders Club exists for grades 6 to 8.
pay_detail: Clubs are free for teens who are Y members. Financial help is available. The page does not give membership prices.
duration: Leaders Club meets weekly. Changemakers meeting schedule and season length not stated.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Register on the Y site or at your local branch.
how_to_apply: Use the Register Now link on the teen community page. Changemakers uses the Teen Clubs sign-up. Or ask at a local YMCA branch.
notes: Leaders Club can include travel to conferences and leadership events. The page does not say how many community service hours a club gives. Which branch runs a club and when is not stated, so ask your local Y. The Y's teens page lists a Legacy Leaders college scholarship for active teen members, with a last day to apply of Sunday, September 13 (year not stated).
